description:
INVITING OFFERS BETWEEN £85,000 AND £90,000
FULL WALK-THROUGH VIDEO!
A one bedroom ground floor apartment set within Victoria Chambers, in the heart of Hull’s Old Town and just off cobbled Bowlalley Lane.The accommodation includes an entrance hallway leading into the living room, with laminate flooring running through the ground floor area. From the living room, stairs lead up to an elevated kitchen area, with cooking facilities and space for a washing machine.
The bedroom sits to the rear and includes a feature fireplace, en-suite bathroom and walk-in dressing room.
This is a straightforward city centre apartment and a great starter for anyone looking to be part of a busy and popular block in Hull’s Old Town.
What We Love“I love being right in the Old Town, with the character of Bowlalley Lane outside and everything feeling close by. It has a real city centre feel, but still feels like a place you can settle into easily.”
